features.title: Serve session search from a worker-owned index
features.summary: Replace the stock sessionQuery backend: searches are pure reads forwarded to a worker that owns the SQLite FTS5 index and ingests session logs incrementally, while list, read and title reads stay core's own code with cached folds.
failureModes: Filters the backend cannot serve are refused with SESSION_QUERY_INVALID_FILTER rather than silently ignored.
An interrupted ingest resumes from the stored per-log cursor instead of restarting the corpus.

verification.testName: lists Sessions once until one is created, disposed, or a listed header changes
folds a Session title once until that Session appends an event

verification.reason: The bundle replaces a Host service backend and renders no UI of its own; the palette and memory finder that call it are verified by their own catalogs, and the cached reads are unit-tested in src/engine-listing.test.ts and src/engine-titles.test.ts.

features.title: Find every match in one thread
features.summary: Return every current-surface event of one Session whose indexed text has all the words typed (the last as a prefix), in transcript order with a short snippet, for the Chat find bar and the thread_find agent tool. An archived Session is indexed for that request.
features.currentSurface: host: session-search findInThread API and thread_find tool
failureModes: Text without a letter or digit returns no matches instead of an FTS5 syntax error.
When another plugin owns sessionQuery, ownsService is false and the caller says the index does not serve the profile.

verification.testName: returns every matching current event of one Session in seq order, with a snippet
reads the owned worker index through the Effect API bridge

verification.reason: The find bar that calls this API belongs to @dshfiles/chat and is walked by its own journey.
